title: ➡️:emoji: Careers Change, Values Don't ✨
content: EmpressCallipygos shares a nugget of wisdom about how to get balance out of life and get through your dreams/career. The heart of it comes from an unexpected college lesson: instead of clinging to one lifelong goal, choose a "spine for your life" aka a personal code or ethos you can carry through whatever work you're doing. Whether you stick with the dream, pivot away from it, or outgrow it entirely, the real win is living in a way that's true to that core value.
author: Brandon Blatcher
